purpose: Produce the missing architect-reviewable raw-schema and per-rule derivation map without allowing an engineer-selected semantic oracle.

authority.precedence: This discovery contract classifies ambiguities and fixes only discovery-package mechanics. V09 bytes remain immutable but are not executable as a complete semantic specification. No discovery classification becomes semantic authority until a later architect-owned execution contract publishes its SHA-256.

immutable_history.preserve_rule: All existing canonical, receipt, temporary-failed, failed-run, failed-receipt, baseline, and architect files are byte-exact immutable.

architect_gap_facts.consequence: A semantic implementation cannot be architect-approved until an exact nested-schema and per-rule dependency/formula map is reviewed and sealed.

rejected_as_proof: The 53/53 negative summary because errors were substring-matched, any nonzero exit was accepted, several clean fixtures were fabricated, and final replay was absent.
The reporter process exit code 0 because semantic_acceptance was false while the CLI returned success.
The current raw captures because stack-frame discovery, root guessing, defaults, sentinels, and empty fixtures were used instead of registered SUT resources.
The current semantic verifier because it did not independently evaluate the 1179 assertions.
Any SEALED_CANDIDATE label inside the quarantined run because canonical_published and receipt_published are false and the directory is a failed namespace.

v09_raw_key_collision_discovery_classifi.reason: V09 lists six source-native capture fields in raw_payload_forbidden_projection_keys while also requiring those exact fields in capture_schemas. This is an architect-contract contradiction, not an engineer-resolvable implementation choice.
v09_raw_key_collision_discovery_classifi.discovery_handling: Inventory these fields as source-native candidates at the named capture/pointer and flag the conflict in the proposal. Do not treat them as approved semantic inputs or as an exception to V09 during acceptance.
v09_raw_key_collision_discovery_classifi.future_resolution_required: A later architect-owned execution contract must either approve exact source-native schema locations or rename the raw fields while retaining V09 projection prohibitions.
v09_raw_key_collision_discovery_classifi.same_keys_elsewhere: They remain prohibited as test-supplied summaries, parent observation projections, reporter-to-verifier actuals, or fields written merely to mirror a V09 projection.

allowed: evidence producer registration refactor needed to expose actual synthetic SUT resources
local tests dedicated to the discovery package
forbidden: broker network access or order submission
deployment, transfer, installation, service mutation, or rollover
canonical readiness run or receipt publication
setting semantic, local acceptance, delivery, proven, parity, safe_to_apply, or apply_allowed claims true

required_order: verify immutable inputs and current source bytes
record a new source baseline without attributing current bytes to run-025
remove implicit resource discovery and fallback capture production
bind concrete resources outside behavior-test bodies
collect a noncanonical targeted and full discovery corpus
publish only a REVIEW_REQUIRED discovery package
stop and return the package to the architect

resource_registration_contract.registration_location: fixture or SUT factory setup; never the behavior-test body
registered_handle_requirements: capture_type equals one of the V09 required_capture_types for the node
each of the 527 required node/capture-type slots per suite registers every concrete resource instance used by the tested public path; a slot may contain one or more instances
each instance has a nonempty stable resource_role describing its domain role rather than its incidental filename or array index
the discovery package proposes the exact resource_role set per node/capture type; the engineer cannot mark that role set architect-approved
the handle is the same object, file, database, subprocess record, or broker stub consumed by the tested public SUT path
resource_instance_id is generated by the plugin at registration and remains identical across before and after
an unbound, ambiguous, or guessed resource instance is BLOCKED and cannot be replaced by the first matching resource
capture errors fail the test session; they never produce an empty or default payload
forbidden_implementation_mechanisms: guessing a fixture root from arbitrary Path locals
walking the repository to guess the SUT resource
catching a capture exception and returning an empty collection
current wall-clock time as a substitute for an invocation time
hardcoded fixture-observation, observed-filter, test-boundary, observed-policy, argv python, empty release, empty rollback, empty AST, or default risk payloads

sdk_call_row_minimum_schema.count_rule: Count only after-slice rows whose action_raw strictly equals the corresponding captured integer constant. String containment and sent-count fabrication are forbidden.

proposal_package.id_selection: first positive three-digit proposal id absent across temp, review-required, failed, and receipt namespaces
proposal_package.manifest_rule: Every package member except discovery-output-manifest.json appears exactly once with normalized relative path, byte count, and SHA-256; manifest is create-new and last.
proposal_package.final_state_rule: The package is review evidence only. PUBLISHED, SEALED, PASS_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, or AUTHORITATIVE may not be used as a state value; authoritative must remain the boolean false.

requirements: every captured resource instance phase has exactly one root schema binding
all object schemas declare required and additionalProperties false
all arrays declare items and exact ordering/cardinality rules
variants use oneOf with a closed discriminator and const values
dynamic maps are represented as arrays of closed key/value records with uniqueness and deterministic key ordering
SHA-256, RFC3339, normalized path, finite-number, duplicate-key, canonical JSON, and raw-byte rules are explicit
schema exhaustiveness cites a production source model, SQLite DDL, public serializer, or public harness serializer; observed examples alone are insufficient
the 39 closed_object fields and two closed_member_object fields identified in V09 are recursively resolved or explicitly BLOCKED

semantic_derivation_proposal_entry.rule_set: exact key set of all V09 behavior_bindings assertions
proposed_single_candidate_requires: dependency specs are nonempty and every logical selector resolves in targeted and full probe captures
targeted and full formulas produce the same V09 expected value without consuming test assertions, reporter output, or runtime expected fields
source citations include at least one SEMANTIC_OWNER public production or public harness source and one ADAPTER_OR_SOURCE_MODEL source; a behavior test is never the sole semantic authority
a format-valid counterfactual witness recipe is proposed
semantic_derivation_proposal_entry.blocked_entry_rule: A BLOCKED entry may use empty dependency specs, null formula ASTs, null probe derivations, and a null witness proposal, but must have nonempty ambiguities and exactly one matching unresolved-rules entry.

requirements: selectors identify logical records by schema fields, primary keys, resource role, and deterministic sort keys rather than incidental array indexes
every scalar read while filtering, sorting, discriminating, or projecting is included in the resolved access set
missing and multiple-match behavior is explicitly BLOCKED; first-match behavior is forbidden
each node has a closed selector object shape with no unknown fields
typed_selector_ast_proposal_contract.future_contract_requirement: A later architect-owned contract must publish exact arity, operand type, return type, collation, cardinality, missing/multiple-match, timestamp, and numeric semantics for every approved selector op.

allowed_diff_roles_exact: raw blob byte count and SHA-256
selected payload reference byte count and SHA-256
envelope payload_bytes and payload_sha256 plus envelope byte count and SHA-256
parent raw_sources phase bytes, sha256, payload_bytes, and payload_sha256

formula_ast_contract.terminal_raw_access: Only RAW with a dependency_id declared by the same rule is permitted.
formula_ast_contract.constant_access: V09_CONST_REF may not point to the same assertion right/expected/projection subtree or reproduce its serialized/hash value. Any other proposed constant must identify an exact V09 pointer and a non-assertion domain role.
formula_ast_contract.domain_outcome_exception: DERIVE_DOMAIN_OUTCOME may emit its exact V09 right literal only after raw branch predicates are true; the literal may not be used as a predicate.
formula_ast_contract.case_or_if_requirements: Predicates must read declared raw dependencies, branches must be exhaustive and type-equal, and an unconditional/default branch that merely emits the expected literal is forbidden.
formula_ast_contract.future_contract_requirement: A later architect-owned execution contract must publish a closed AST object schema and exact arity, input/output type, missing/type error, sort collation, cardinality, timestamp normalization, numeric, and CASE evaluation semantics for every approved op.
forbidden: test assertion or JUnit message as semantic input
reporter or verifier output as the other evaluator input

counterfactual_design_policy.selection: Every rule requires its own architect-approved witness recipe. A global first capture, after phase, lexicographic scalar, or primitive-type-only mutation rule is forbidden.
reason_global_selection_is_invalid: zero-count rules may depend on empty array membership and have no eligible scalar
SHA-256, RFC3339, normalized path, and enum strings require format-specific mutations
state_before and clean-snapshot rules cannot be invalidated by blindly mutating an after scalar
SQLite dependencies require typed table/primary-key/column operations rather than a JSON pointer or corrupting byte flip
counterfactual_design_policy.decoded_error_array_later: exact ordered singleton; exit code exactly 1; no schema, identity, hash, or unrelated semantic error

source_inventory_contract.allowed_diff_purpose: Concrete-resource registration and discovery-package generation/validation only; production inputs, assertions, expected literals, and public SUT behavior may not change.
source_inventory_contract.run_025_attribution_rule: The one runner change occurred after run-025. It is current baseline drift, not an inside-attempt integrity failure and not source that may be attributed to run-025.

probe_registration_status_contract.blocked_behavior: Run the underlying local synthetic behavior test but emit no parent observation or raw capture for the blocked slot; record only the blocker in the discovery ledger.

required_checks: history bytes match before and after
1179 unique rule entries equal the V09 rule set
164 unique node ids equal the V09 behavior set
all 17 capture types have recursively closed Draft 2020-12 schema candidates when captured or an exact review blocker
every rule has a nonempty logical dependency proposal or an exact BLOCKED status
no logical selector uses /payload as its terminal selection
no selector or witness contains a placeholder
no formula contains a forbidden op
no source citation uses an absolute or temp path
no probe consumes a test expected, assertion output, reporter output, or verifier output
527 required node/capture-type slots per suite are represented in the role-set proposal; actual instance cardinality is recomputed from proposed roles and never hardcoded to 527
captured entries contain real raw blobs and blocked entries contain no fabricated observation or payload

parent raw refs bind envelope bytes and SHA-256; envelopes bind raw blob bytes and SHA-256; all envelope/ref schemas, identities, phases, resource roles, instance ids, canonical serialization, and multiplicities are exact
all JSON identity fields and manifests are internally consistent
discovery-readiness remains REVIEW_REQUIRED and every readiness/apply/proof claim remains false
proposal_validation.proposal_complete_formula: unresolved_rule_count == 0 AND blocked_schema_count == 0 AND all 527 capture-role-set rows have status PROPOSED_SINGLE_CANDIDATE AND each targeted role set equals its full role set AND each suite ledger captured-entry count equals the sum of proposed role cardinalities AND every captured instance phase has a closed root schema binding
proposal_validation.implementation_allowed_formula: false until a later architect-owned immutable semantic mapping contract publishes its SHA-256
review_blockers: BLOCKED resource, role set, raw schema, selector, formula, source citation, type, or counterfactual witness
targeted/full proposed source-model variance that requires an architect decision
fatal_structural_errors: source change outside the explicit discovery allowlist
missing, duplicate, or extra V09 rule or node/capture-type slot
fabricated raw payload for a blocked slot
proposal_validation.exit_policy: A structurally valid REVIEW_REQUIRED package may exit 0 with review blockers and proposal_complete=false. Fatal structural errors exit nonzero and retain the attempt under the exact failed name. Exit 0 never means semantic PASS or implementation approval.

stop_conditions: Any immutable input or history mismatch
Any source change outside the explicit discovery allowlist
Any attempt to fabricate a raw capture for a review blocker
Any proposal package structural, identity, path, or manifest failure
Any real environment, broker, MT5, scheduler, deployment, release, or signing action would be required
review_blocker_handling: Ambiguous or missing resource, role, schema, selector, formula, citation, type, or witness is recorded as BLOCKED with no fabricated raw evidence; complete the structurally valid REVIEW_REQUIRED package and return it to the architect.
handoff_rule: Return the review package and unresolved lists to the architect. Do not implement the semantic engines, execute the 1179 counterfactuals, rerun the 53 negative acceptance gate, select a readiness run id, or publish a canonical run until a later architect instruction binds an immutable per-rule mapping SHA-256.
